meta.title: Muito Bala · Your audiovisual paradise
meta.description: Audiovisual production house from Porto Alegre, Brazil. Film, photo, music and design with the look of a 90s Miami summer. Welcome to our vibe.
meta.ogDescription: Film, photo, music and design. Welcome to our vibe.

ticker.before: Nothing is as hot as a brand that makes the market

clients.title: Brands Muito Bala has worked with

manifest.title: The vibe
manifest.p1: The internet taught everyone to swipe in three seconds. We shoot on a Handycam, record to tape and develop slowly, because what is truly good rewards the ones who stay.
manifest.p2: Whoever stays until the end is exactly who your brand was hoping to find. Serious work, easy feeling, and here anything goes.

services.intro: Film, photo, music and design under one roof. We deliver the whole project, from the first sketch to the final cut. Grab a card and drag it across the table.
services.hint: ↔ drag the cards across the table

design.title: Design.
design.description: Identity, art direction and everything that has to look good before the camera rolls. Around here, Monique Borba does the drawing.

musica.title: Music Production.
musica.description: Recording studio and original soundtracks, the sound that lets the image breathe. On headphones, Leonardo Cassiano.

video.title: Film Production.
video.description: Directing, script and film, from the set to the edit suite. Behind the camera, Nani ArtClub.

foto.title: Photography.
foto.description: Glowing skin, soft light and period chrome, with a touch of humor. From brand shoots to product stills.

thesis.before: We Don't Deliver Audiences. We Deliver

figs.title: The vibe's instruction manual
figs.intro: Three things that come standard with every Muito Bala project.

items.title: No fear of looking silly
items.text: Muito bala is its own yardstick. We take the risk of doing things differently, embrace the goofy and the comic, and turn it into images nobody forgets.
items.alt: Tanned back with the Muito Bala logo drawn by the sun, by the pool
items.caption: tan line

items.title: Truly analog
items.text: Handycam, Cybershot, vinyl and cassette. It is not nostalgia. It is proof that you can still make someone stop and look calmly, and that it still works very well.
items.alt: Vinyl record with a blue sleeve and the Muito Bala logo in pink
items.caption: side A

items.title: Serious work, easy feeling
items.text: Our strong suit is the experience. A calm set, honest conversation and delivery on time. You walk out of the project with the material ready and wanting to come back.
items.alt: Gardener in a light suit trimming a hedge sculpture shaped like the MB monogram
items.caption: happy client, natural habitat
